title: Norris Durham
clean_html:
Norris Durham

Preserved Primary Document • durhm-n1.htm

Norris worked for the Delaware State Highway Dept. for over 26 years before retiring in 1979. He and his wife, Dorothy, had the following children: Janet Christine Durham (died before 1998) Norris Edward Durham Jr. Norris died on Saturday, 3 January, 1998 of renal failure. He was buried in Sharon Hill Memorial Park in Dover, DE.
